question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as CCP General Secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against removal before 2027. No institutional trigger exists ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in autumn 2027, where a fourth term remains the anticipated outcome. Recent personnel appointments, military leadership changes, and an October 2026 plenum focused on party discipline have reinforced rather than challenged elite cohesion, while public appearances and policy continuity through mid-2026 show no factional challenges or health signals. Historical patterns tie abrupt leadership shifts to scheduled congresses rather than mid-term ousters. Unforeseen medical events, an acute economic downturn prompting internal consensus shifts, or a major external crisis could still alter elite alignments before December 2026.
